description: This Java source file defines the UploadChanges class responsible for uploading configuration changes via a GUI and serial port communication in the rusEfi project. It manages UI initialization, serial port setup, reading configuration images from files, and performing uploads asynchronously.

classes.name: UploadChanges
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing UI interactions and serial communication to upload configuration changes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point. Sets up the UI and serial port based on the argument.

methods.name: showUi
methods.description: Initializes serial port, loads configuration images, and prepares for uploading.

methods.name: scheduleUpload
methods.description: Schedules an upload of the new configuration image.

methods.name: createUiLogger
methods.description: Creates a Logger implementation that outputs messages to the UI and console.
